24.notes: Table A applies to a listed set of High End Brands (all origins); Table B to a listed set of Medium/Low End Brands, with origin-specific values. The brand lists are not transcribed. The variant states the table and the 'standard weight/volume of unit (net content)' printed in the table (units of that figure not printed). Table A row 12 prints PCT as '304.9110' (apparently 3304.9110; WeBOC 3304.9110.1020 printed) - transcribed as 3304.9110. In Table B the WeBOC code 3304.9110.1060 is printed for both Foundation Paint Stick rows and 3304.9190.1030 for both China/Sri-Lanka and Others of Liquid Makeup, as printed. Notes (i)-(iv) say values are for standard packing weight with prorata for other weights; not applicable to multinational direct imports; gift sets assessed per item. Standard net content for Eye Lash differs between tables (0.5 vs 1). Supersession clause prints 'Nos.1374/2019 dated 20-05-2019'.

Note-I on page 5: the values apply to China, Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam origin only; other origins are assessed with a 5% increase. Note-II: for dyed or coloured goods add US$ 0.90/Kg. Values are described as minimum customs values. Item 4(b) cells for counts 26 and 30 are faint and were read twice at high zoom as 2.50 and 2.58. Item 3(d) (50% Polyester / 50% Viscose) count 50: the last digit prints as 8 in the first reading and as 9 at 24x zoom (2.58 / 2.59); left out rather than guessed - 1 value missing.
